+def catmull(points: np.ndarray, subdivisions: int = 10) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Centripetal-ish cubic interpolation for smooth centerline anchors."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
+    # Endpoint extension avoids flattening the first and last tangents.
+    ext = np.vstack([2*p[0]-p[1], p, 2*p[-1]-p[-2]])
+    out = []
+    for i in range(1, len(ext)-2):
+        p0,p1,p2,p3 = ext[i-1:i+3]

+    arc=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(seg)]

+    qs=np.arange(0,total,step_mm/(PX_M*1000.0))
+    if len(qs)==0 or qs[-1] < total: qs=np.r_[qs,total]
+    out=np.column_stack([np.interp(q,arc,uv[:,j]) for j in range(2)])

+    vi=np.clip(np.round(raw[:,1]).astype(int),0,1023)

+    and backward tail. Starts begin one drag length ahead; interior points are
+    centered over root+tail; terminal points ease back so lifting releases at
+    the exemplar endpoint.

+    start_ramp=start_ramp*start_ramp*(3-2*start_ramp)
+    shift=sh+(mid-sh)*start_ramp
